## Purpose & Scope  
### Purpose  
To establish procedures for personal data protection that:
- Comply with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act
- Respect customer privacy rights
- Secure personal data against unauthorized access
- Manage customer subject access requests
- Implement data subject rights (access, erasure, portability)

raw_entities.name: Personal Data Protection Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal policy establishing procedures for personal data protection that comply with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act. The policy governs customer privacy rights, data security, subject access requests, and implementation of data subject rights including access, erasure, and portability.
context: To establish procedures for personal data protection that: Comply with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act
Respect customer privacy rights
Secure personal data against unauthorized access
Manage customer subject access requests
Implement data subject rights (access, erasure, portability)

raw_entities.name: General Data Protection Regulation
raw_entities.description: EU regulation establishing requirements for personal data protection and privacy rights. This policy must comply with GDPR requirements.
context: Comply with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act

raw_entities.name: UK Data Protection Act
raw_entities.description: UK legislation governing personal data protection and privacy. This policy must comply with UK Data Protection Act requirements.
context: Comply with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Data Access
raw_entities.description: The risk of personal data being accessed without authorization. The policy addresses this risk through data security measures and access controls.
context: Secure personal data against unauthorized access

raw_entities.name: Privacy Rights Violation
raw_entities.description: The risk of failing to respect and uphold customer privacy rights. The policy mitigates this through procedures that respect customer privacy rights.
context: Respect customer privacy rights

raw_entities.name: Compliance with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to ensure all personal data protection procedures comply with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act requirements.
context: Comply with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act

raw_entities.name: Customer Privacy Rights Protection
raw_entities.description: Obligation to respect and protect customer privacy rights throughout all data handling processes.
context: Respect customer privacy rights

raw_entities.name: Personal Data Security Against Unauthorized Access
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to implement security measures that protect personal data against unauthorized access.
context: Secure personal data against unauthorized access

raw_entities.name: Customer Subject Access Request Management
raw_entities.description: Obligation to establish and maintain procedures for managing customer subject access requests in compliance with data protection regulations.
context: Manage customer subject access requests

raw_entities.name: Implementation of Data Subject Rights
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to implement and facilitate data subject rights including access, erasure, and portability of personal data.
context: Implement data subject rights (access, erasure, portability)

raw_entities.name: Data Security Controls
raw_entities.description: Operational safeguards implemented to secure personal data against unauthorized access. These controls are required to protect customer information throughout its lifecycle.
context: Secure personal data against unauthorized access

raw_entities.name: Subject Access Request Processing
raw_entities.description: Operational procedure for receiving, processing, and responding to customer subject access requests in compliance with regulatory requirements.
context: Manage customer subject access requests

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Natural persons who hold banking relationships and whose personal data is subject to protection under this policy. Customers have privacy rights and can exercise data subject rights.
context: Respect customer privacy rights
Manage customer subject access requests
Implement data subject rights (access, erasure, portability)
